Information *****PLEASE READ****** A minimum of one field must be populated to execute a search. Enter as much Information as needed to narrow your search.
When searching by document number, the number format is YYYY-12345, for example 2024-01234. All numbers are required. 
To search the Online Index Books, navigate to the Document Types field and begin typing ONLINE INDEX BOOKS. Select the appropriate book type and click Search. The Document No field will provide the details of the specific book. Click image icon to navigate through all pages of the book.Plat Index Books are included in ONLINE INDEX BOOKS - PLATS. Please utilize Chrome or Microsoft Edge web browsers when searching in AVA.
